title: Route Optimizer
summary: Sequences collection stops into a short round trip and computes distance matrices.

trade.notes: Pure computation — no datastore, no outbound calls, no persistent state. Horizontally scalable behind any load balancer.

settlement.counterparty_note: COMPLETE AT SIGNING — no counterparty agreed at the time of writing.
settlement.rationale: Pure computation with no state and no dependencies. Horizontally scalable, so it is worth more to an operator with routing volume than to us.

endpoints.summary: Sequence stops into a short route

alias_endpoints.summary: Flat alias for POST /api/v1/optimize. bins=[...] must carry coordinates; a stateless optimizer cannot resolve bin ids.
